description: This source file implements a Python script for uploading data to S3, managing Kuksa clients (VAL server and DataBroker), and packing data into Parquet files for storage and transfer. It includes classes for S3 interaction, Kuksa client handling, and Parquet file creation, along with a main function to run the data collection and upload loop.

classes.name: ServerType
classes.description: Enumeration for server types: KUKSA_VAL_SERVER and KUKSA_DATABROKER.

classes.name: S3Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with AWS S3, including bucket creation and file upload.

classes.name: KuksaClientError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Kuksa client errors, with methods to create instances from VISS and gRPC errors.

classes.name: KuksaClient
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate specific Kuksa client based on configuration.

classes.name: KuksaVALServerClient
classes.description: Client for Kuksa VAL server, retrieves data types and values via KuksaClientThread.

classes.name: KuksaDatabrokerClient
classes.description: Client for Kuksa DataBroker, retrieves data types and values via gRPC.

classes.name: ParquetPacker
classes.description: Handles data collection, schema generation, and writing data into Parquet files, with periodic upload to S3.

methods.name: from_config
methods.description: Creates a KuksaClient instance based on configuration, selecting between VAL server and DataBroker.

methods.name: get_datatypes
methods.description: Retrieves data types for specified paths from Kuksa server.

methods.name: get_values
methods.description: Retrieves current values for specified paths from Kuksa server.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Kuksa client connection.

methods.name: create_new_parquet
methods.description: Creates a new Parquet file with timestamped filename.

methods.name: gen_schema
methods.description: Generates a PyArrow schema based on data types of specified paths.

methods.name: write_table
methods.description: Writes data to the current Parquet file, creating a new file if max rows are reached.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop for periodic data collection and writing.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Parquet packer, including closing files and cleaning up.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize configuration, start the data collection loop, and handle termination signals.
